map.输入母材材料、板厚与焊接位置，推荐焊条/焊丝型号及直径: Enter the base material, plate thickness and welding position to get recommended electrode and wire models plus diameters
map.💡 焊材选用遵循等强匹配原则；不锈钢按母材成分选相应型号；立焊仰焊焊条直径≤4m: 💡 Consumable selection follows the equal-strength matching principle; for stainless steel pick the matching grade by base composition; electrodes for vertical and overhead positions should be 4 mm or smaller.
map.焊材型号仅供参考，正式选用应以工艺评定为准: The consumable grades are for reference only; the official choice should follow the qualified welding procedure
map.重要结构应选用低氢型焊条并按规定烘干: Critical structures should use low-hydrogen electrodes and bake them as specified
map.📚 深度解析：焊材选用推荐: 📚 In-depth analysis: welding consumable selection recommendation
map.按母材牌号查推荐焊条与焊丝型号，遵循等强匹配原则选材。: Look up the recommended electrode and wire grades by base material grade, selecting consumables by the equal-strength matching principle.
map.按板厚选择焊条直径，并按焊接位置修正（立焊、仰焊不宜用粗焊条）。: Choose the electrode diameter by plate thickness and correct it for the welding position (thick electrodes are unsuitable for vertical and overhead welding).
map.给出参考电流范围，作为试焊调参的起点。: Give a reference current range as the starting point for test-welding parameter tuning.
map.常用匹配：Q235 → E4303(J422)/E4315(J427)、焊丝 E: Common matches: Q235 → E4303(J422)/E4315(J427), wire ER50-6; Q345 → E5015(J507)/E5016(J506), wire ER50-6; 20 steel → same as Q235; 304 stainless → E308-16(A102)/E308-15(A107), wire ER308; 316 → E316-16(A202)/E316-15(A207), wire ER316. Electrode diameter by plate thickness: under 4 mm use 2.5, 4~12 mm use 3.2, 12~25 mm use 4.0, 25 mm or more use 5.0 mm; for vertical (PF) and overhead (PE) positions keep the diameter at or below 4 mm. Reference current = 40 × diameter (mm), with ±15% tolerance.
map.Q345 钢、板厚 16 mm、横焊位置：推荐焊条 E5015(J507)，直径: Q345 steel, 16 mm plate thickness, horizontal welding position: recommended electrode E5015(J507), 4.0 mm diameter (16 mm falls in the 12~25 mm range), reference current = 40×4 = 160 A, roughly 136~184 A. At the same thickness in the vertical position the diameter stays 4.0 mm (still under the limit), but in operation you should use the lower end of the current range for better weld pool control.
map.焊缝金属的强度（尤其是屈服与抗拉）应与母材相当。选低了接头强度不足，选过高则焊缝: The strength of the weld metal (especially yield and tensile strength) should be comparable to the base material. Choosing too low leaves the joint under-strength; choosing too high gives a weld with poor ductility and high residual stress, and may initiate cracks.
map.不锈钢焊材为什么按成分选？: Why are stainless steel consumables selected by composition?
map.不锈钢焊材需与母材的铬镍体系对应（如 304 配 308 系列、316 配 31: Stainless steel consumables must match the chromium-nickel system of the base material (for example 304 with the 308 series, 316 with the 316 series), so that the weld keeps its corrosion resistance and metallurgical structure (avoiding carbide precipitation or an unfavorable amount of ferrite).
map.关于「焊材选用推荐」: About the Welding Consumable Selection Recommendation
map.焊材选用推荐工具，输入母材材料（Q235/Q345/304/316/20钢）、板: The welding consumable selection tool takes the base material (Q235/Q345/304/316/20 steel), plate thickness and welding position, then recommends matching electrode grades, wire grades, electrode diameter and reference current to support consumable selection.
